name: suspect-vscode
description: Run Arazzo workflows, drive the mock gateway, and generate canonical SDKs, documentation or custom templates from OpenAPI documents.

suspect.codegen.compatibilityProfiles.markdownDescription: Versioned source interpretations to opt into (`suspect gen sdk --compatibility-profile`). Empty keeps ordinary OpenAPI semantics. `codegen.compatibility_profiles` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `[]`).

suspect.codegen.importNames.markdownDescription: SDK profile to native import/module/namespace name, for example `{python-http: widgets_sdk}`. A profile without an entry derives its name from the package name. `codegen.import_names` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `{}`).

suspect.codegen.operationIds.markdownDescription: Exact `operationId`s to generate. Empty attempts every operation; an unsupported one fails rather than being dropped. `codegen.operation_ids` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `[]`).

suspect.codegen.packageName.markdownDescription: Native package identity, independent of the API title. The editor's SDK commands and Live SDK Preview start from it. `codegen.package_name` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.codegen.packageVersion.markdownDescription: Default package SemVer, independent of `info.version`. Swift requires a stable version (no prerelease or build metadata). `codegen.package_version` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.codegen.session.config.markdownDescription: Session config (JSON) naming the spec and targets. Unset: the editor asks for one. `codegen.session.config` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.codegen.session.out.markdownDescription: Initial output root for session preview/watch/drift checks, relative to the session config's directory (not `codegen.out`). `codegen.session.out` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `sdk-out`).

suspect.diff.baseline.markdownDescription: Git ref compared against for breaking changes (`suspect ci`, the editor's breaking-changes command; the editor falls back to `HEAD~1`). `diff.baseline` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.editor.inlayHints.properties.markdownDescription: Show property type-annotation inlay hints. `editor.inlay_hints.properties` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `true`).

suspect.editor.inlayHints.refs.markdownDescription: Show resolved `$ref` target inlay hints. `editor.inlay_hints.refs` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `true`).

suspect.format.sortKeys.markdownDescription: Reorder object keys into the canonical OpenAPI order when formatting. Defaults to `true` when a `format` section exists, else `false`. `format.sort_keys` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `false`).

suspect.gateway.port.markdownDescription: Port the gateway listens on. `gateway.port` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `8080`).

suspect.lint.design.markdownDescription: Severity for design-class rules: findings that flag the API's design rather than the document's accuracy. A project documenting an API it does not own sets `off` (or `info` to keep them as notes); `lint.rules` wins per rule. `lint.design` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.lint.minSeverity.markdownDescription: Minimum severity to report. Findings below this floor are suppressed. `lint.min_severity` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `hint`).

suspect.lint.recommended.markdownDescription: Apply the recommended (built-in) lint rule set. With `false` and no `lint.ruleset`, no lint rules run. `lint.recommended` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `true`).

suspect.lint.rules.markdownDescription: Rule id to severity (`error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint`, `off`), overriding the severity a rule would otherwise produce. Merged per rule across files. `lint.rules` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `{}`).

suspect.lint.ruleset.markdownDescription: Custom ruleset document, relative to the file that sets it. `lint.ruleset` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value.

suspect.ref.maxDocs.markdownDescription: Maximum documents loaded in one ref workspace. `ref.max_docs` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `500`).

suspect.test.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL requests are sent to. `test.base_url` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `http://localhost:8080`).

suspect.validate.strictFormat.markdownDescription: Assert `format` keywords. The 2020-12 default is annotation-only, so this catches example drift that annotation-only mode would let through. `validate.strict_format` in `.suspect.yaml`; unset (`null`) uses the committed value (default `false`).

suspect.basePath.description: Path to the suspect CLI: a directory containing the `suspect` executable, the executable itself, or bare `suspect` to resolve from $PATH.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No suspect.project.json in this workspace.

A project manifest names the entry spec, publish profiles, SDK targets and contract-test suites; this view shows them and the Testing view runs them.

Arazzo workflows are still discovered by content and listed in the Testing view.
[Open Testing](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openWorkspaceSettings?%22suspect%22)
